_comment: Abyss collection (the void, not the sea: Deep Sea is deep_sea.json). Each name in 'lines' brings in its WHOLE evolutionary line. The 18 lines were picked with `generate.py pick --count 18 --seed abyss-void-gaze` after Arc Light's, then given a look each (three lines per look). Shared look in styles/_void.py, one thin module per look.

readme.title: Abyss
readme.summary: Pokemon touched by the void that stares back: starless darkness, glowing rifts, watching eyes, shadow flames, eldritch sigils and pulsing veins.
looks: each line wears one look: the void, inky starless black with drifting violet motes (the Eevee family, Magikarp, Sandygast); rift, obsidian split by glowing magenta cracks (Geodude, Nosepass, Tyrunt); eyes, a dark hide covered in blinking yellow eyes (Natu, Caterpie, Gimmighoul); shadowflame, violet flames licking up from the feet (Sneasel, Nidoran M, Chespin); sigil, glowing green rune circles and glyph bands (Tapu Koko, Tapu Fini, Dwebble); veins, branching red veins that pulse (Clamperl, Snivy, Lillipup)
the void's light glows in the dark and moves: motes drift, rifts throb, eyes blink, flames flicker, veins pulse; glowing eyes
shiny: the void's light turned round the colour wheel
